title: Let service become the way across
summary: This meets the useful life that is still spiritually unplaced. The line says service is not merely good activity; through the Shabad it becomes a path across.
takeaway: Serve in a way the Shabad can carry.
lifeApplication: Before adding another impressive task, choose the act that actually helps you cross: guided, quiet, and answered to the Guru.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes a path across when the Shabad leads it.
source.lifeApplication: When the day feels aimless, choose service the Shabad can actually carry.

evidence.coreClaim: Service becomes a path across when the Shabad leads it.
evidence.turn: The path becomes visible when service turns fruitful.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before adding another impressive task, choose the act that actually helps you cross: guided, quiet, and answered to the Guru.
